'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**The [[Iranian government]] gives its first official report regarding deaths from the protests that followed the [[death of Mahsa Amini]] in September. The report states that more than 200 people have died in what the government has labelled as "[[riot]]s". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/3/iran-says-over-200-killed-in-countrys-ongoing-unrest (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Hunter Biden laptop controversy]]
**Internal documents released by [[Twitter]] CEO [[Elon Musk]] show that staff at the company suppressed posts discussing the October 2020 ''[[New York Post]]'' article on the [[Hunter Biden]] [[Hunter Biden laptop controversy|laptop story]] ahead of the [[2020 United States presidential election]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/brianbushard/2022/12/03/musks-twitter-files-internal-hunter-biden-debate-revealed-with-much-hype-but-no-bombshells/ (Forbes)]
